Class FhirSpanDecorator

java.lang.Object
org.apache.camel.telemetry.decorators.AbstractSpanDecorator
org.openehealth.ipf.platform.camel.ihe.core.IpfSpanDecorator
org.openehealth.ipf.platform.camel.ihe.fhir.core.FhirSpanDecorator
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.camel.telemetry.SpanDecorator
Direct Known Subclasses:
AtnaIti81SpanDecorator, ChPpq3SpanDecorator, ChPpq4SpanDecorator, ChPpq5SpanDecorator, CmpdPharm5SpanDecorator, CustomFhirSpanDecorator, MhdIti105SpanDecorator, MhdIti65SpanDecorator, MhdIti66SpanDecorator, MhdIti67SpanDecorator, MhdIti68BinSpanDecorator, MhdIti68SpanDecorator, PdqmIti119SpanDecorator, PdqmIti78SpanDecorator, PixmIti104SpanDecorator, PixmIti83SpanDecorator, QedmPcc44SpanDecorator
public abstract class FhirSpanDecorator extends IpfSpanDecorator
Base class for the span decorators of the FHIR based transactions.

On top of the transaction metadata contributed by the superclass, the FHIR version is added: the same transaction may be offered for more than one FHIR version, under the same endpoint scheme, so the version is what tells the spans of the two apart.

Trace context propagation is not implemented here: it is performed by the HTTP client and server the FHIR endpoints are built on, whose instrumentation establishes the context before the exchange reaches the Camel route and injects it into the outgoing HTTP headers.
